title: Part Twenty: Yeshua, Paul and the First Followers

sections.brief: The historical Yeshua: name (Yeshua/Yehoshua) and the Yeshua vs Jesus Christ naming choice; dates (c.6-4 BCE; 30-36 CE under Pilate); Josephus Ant. 20 (James) and the Testimonium debate (partial interpolation; Olson minority); Tacitus Annals 15.44; Nostra Aetate 4 on collective guilt; Mark c.70 after Paul; kingdom sayings (Mark 1:15, Luke 17:21 entos hymon dispute with Ramelli 2009, Thomas 3 and 113, Thomas dating range); the image of Jesus (Taylor 2018, Blum and Harvey 2012, Sallman 1940). Figures: fig-time (earliest witnesses), fig-compare (Luke 17:21 renderings)

Paul: life and death dates; 13 letters bearing his name, 7 undisputed, Hebrews anonymous; revelation claim (Gal 1) vs received tradition (1 Cor 11, 15) and marked sayings (1 Cor 7); met Cephas 15 days and James (Gal 1:18-19); Jerusalem meeting c.48-50 (Gal 2 / Acts 15) as the council Paul attended, not Nicaea; Antioch quarrel; what Paul did not found. Figures: fig-compare (sources of his message), fig-time (career)

House churches (Acts 2, Rom 16; Dura-Europos later); Pliny Ep. 10.96; women named (Phoebe, Junia, Pliny's deaconesses); common purse in Acts 2-5 as the community's own account; Paul's voluntary collection (1 Cor 16, 2 Cor 9); Didache on prophets, first-fruits and appointing bishops; Justin 1 Apol. 67; Irenaeus AH IV.18 on tithes; no tithe system until Tours 567 / Macon 585 (flag to vt31); Ignatius and the single bishop. Figures: fig-flow (money in the early communities), fig-compare (Didache vs Ignatius leadership)
